title: SQLPanel code elements don't wrap
author: tim-schilling
body_preview: When viewing the explain output of toolbar v8 and Django 6.1, the SQL content is very long and renders on a single line. The user has to horizontally scroll to view the content. title: Better handle LLM generated PRs
author: tim-schilling
body_preview: It turns out LLMs are crap at following GitHub PR templates. What do people think about a light GitHub bot that spots that the PR template wasn't used and comments with a response that indicates they should switch to the PR template and if they're using AI, give them a prompt to make sure their submission is manageable?  I really don't enjoy reading 500 word PR descriptions for a +15 line change....
